messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Launchboard ceremony: request for OKR endorsement and QBR readout rehearsal

Team —

Attached is the Q3 OKR slate (v2) and the stakeholder matrix for the upcoming Launchboard ceremony / QBR readout. We need leadership endorsement of the objectives and key results by EOD Monday so we can lock slides and the rehearsal schedule. High-level asks: 

- Please confirm endorsement (or provide redlines) for the OKR language.
- Review owners and measurement leads in the stakeholder matrix — mark any mismatches.
- Confirm availability for a 45-minute run-through week of Aug 24.

One specific ask for Kimberly: could you validate the quant targets on the Cost/Latency objective (page 3)? I pulled telemetry but want your sign-off before we publish.

I propose these rehearsal slots (tentative):
- Tue 2026-08-25 10:00–10:45 PT (preferred)
- Wed 2026-08-26 14:00–14:45 PT

Attachments: Q3_OKR_slate_v2.pdf, stakeholder-matrix.xlsx

Thanks —
Michael
Michael Grant
Head of Product Operations | Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwoodinference.com | 415-555-0162

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 11:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Launchboard ceremony: request for OKR endorsement and QBR readout rehearsal

Michael —

Thanks for the draft. Quick read — overall good. A couple of specific notes: 

- Cost/Latency objective: the 20% latency reduction number on page 3 assumes the new batching config; suggest we qualify as "targeting 15–20%" unless we decide to ship batching changes before the quarter.
- Measurement leads: I've moved Platform Metrics ownership from Jenna to me (see stakeholder-matrix.xlsx). Please ensure the doc reflects that.
- Suggested wording tweak for Objective 2, first bullet — replace "drive adoption" with "accelerate integration" to be more action-oriented.

I can join the Tue 25th slot but prefer the 14:00 Wed slot if Rishi can't make mornings.

Attaching a redline summary (inline comments in the Drive doc as well).

Kimberly Park
VP, Product Strategy | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
